source: Original Social Wars 0.02a SWF in Chromium/Ruffle with original Flask server on loopback

observed_fx_requests.conclusion: Every FX SWF was requested during client boot, before any manual unit selection; a later attack did not need another network request. Loading is not proof that each loaded asset rendered in the specific fight.

no_unit_input_control.visual_observation: Original SWF shows Bushwacker firing; red damage numbers and bright impact on Reaper Drone before disappearance; XP and gold rewards visible after death.
no_unit_input_control.interpretation: The hostile Reaper Drone was killed by the original running client without any clicks on units. This is positive evidence of autonomous engagement for the seeded near_north scenario.

specific_correction_to_5d8j: Previous test verified kill and attack on the original client but did not isolate manual click causation; the 5D8N no-click control demonstrates manual unit clicks are unnecessary at this proximity.
limits: Individual FX loads happened before combat, not specifically at the attack event.
Static mappings from delegate classes identify available FX, but do not map an exact downloaded asset to visible shot/impact pixels.
No unique subframe synchronization from Ruffle to SWF DefineSprite IDs.
Automatic aggression at other distances, teams or terrain configurations remains untested.
The independently rebuilt/recompiled client is not shown to execute this battle.
next_lot: 5D.8O: isolate auto-aggro distance/target selection with controlled enemy placement and screen snapshots; test if attack starts without manual input as distance changes.
